title: RetroNash PentHouse Sleeps 7 terrace Downtown View
description:
The penthouse is located in Nashville, Tennessee, specifically in an area called "The Nations." in West Nashville. 
- **Deck Size**: It features a spacious 30x30 deck for guests to enjoy.
-  **Proximity to Entertainment**: The penthouse is just 4.9 miles from Broadway, Nashville's main party street.
- **Local Breweries and Distilleries**: Guests have easy access to a local brewery and distillery located only 2 blocks from the building, and other great food and coffee options.

The space
This is a 3 bedroom and 2 bathroom condo with a private 30x30 rooftop. 
Bedroom 1: Master bedroom with a queen bed, full bathroom, and footrest automatic T.V.
Bedroom 2: Queen bed, with closet and T..V
Bedroom 3: Queen bed with closet T.V. and 2 make up stations.
Second bathroom: walking shower with  shower tower.  
Living room: with an automatic sleeping sofa, 2 extra chairs, and your personal cocktail cocktail maker. 
Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, breakfast bar seating, cooking essentials, expresso coffee maker (coffee and tea provided) toaster.
Rooftop: with outdoor furniture , swing, T.V,  two launch chairs and corn holes for your entertainment.
Free Parking on the back side of the building.
